title: Ktiv — International Collection of Digitized Hebrew Manuscripts
scope_filter: Select Digital Only and biblical/Tanakh textual witnesses; exclude noncanonical and commentary items from this lane.
completeness_statement: Primary discovery root for digitized Hebrew manuscript witnesses; participating holdings and item availability change over time.
notes: Holding-institution terms govern each digital object.

title: Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library
scope_filter: Use Content = Biblical Compositions; route Non-Biblical and Multiple Compositions through boundary review.
completeness_statement: Official archive with content filters and high-resolution images; canonical-lane selection is narrower than the full archive.
notes: The same archive is also a boundary root with a different content filter.

title: New Testament Virtual Manuscript Room
maintainer: Institut für Neutestamentliche Textforschung, University of Münster
scope_filter: Greek New Testament manuscript catalog and manuscript workspace.
completeness_statement: INTF describes NTVMR as the most exhaustive list of Greek New Testament manuscript resources; image availability is item-dependent.
notes: Scholarly identity and catalog authority; not automatic textual or preferred-reading authority.

title: INTF Liste of Greek New Testament Manuscripts
maintainer: Institut für Neutestamentliche Textforschung, University of Münster
scope_filter: Use Gregory-Aland identities and manuscript details; digital-image links may lead to separate holding institutions.
completeness_statement: Canonical identity spine for Greek New Testament witnesses, complementary to the NTVMR workspace.
notes: Identity/catalog pointer, not a promise of images for every record.

title: CSNTM Manuscript Search
maintainer: Center for the Study of New Testament Manuscripts
scope_filter: Filter by canonical New Testament or relevant LXX book; route deuterocanonical results to boundary review.
completeness_statement: Large scholarly image catalog; current search exposed 2,045 results, but collection and image permissions are item-dependent.
notes: CSNTM directs users to contact it about image use.

title: Göttingen Septuagint Manuscript Catalogue
scope_filter: Select witnesses/components corresponding to the default 66-book lane; route deuterocanonical components separately.
completeness_statement: Scholarly Rahlfs-based Septuagint witness catalog; digital facsimile availability varies by holding institution.
notes: Mixed-canon manuscripts must be split by content component.

title: Coptic Old Testament Virtual Manuscript Room
scope_filter: Select Coptic witnesses to default-66 Old Testament books; tradition-specific additional books route to boundary.
completeness_statement: Scholarly discovery and manuscript workspace for the Coptic Old Testament; image coverage varies.
notes: Canon profile must remain explicit.

title: vHMML Reading Room
scope_filter: Search Bible/Gospels/Pentateuch/Psalter and verify each work component; route liturgical, patristic, and noncanonical components separately.
completeness_statement: Major manuscript preservation portal with strong Eastern Christian coverage; not a Bible-only enumerating catalog.
notes: Login or holding-institution conditions may apply.

title: Syriaca.org
scope_filter: Use for Syriac manuscript identities and holding references; admit only canonical-66 content pointers to this lane.
completeness_statement: Scholarly Syriac reference infrastructure; direct facsimiles generally reside at holding institutions.
notes: Discovery aid, not digital-copy authority by itself.

title: DigiVatLib Manuscripts
scope_filter: Search biblical shelfmarks/titles and split mixed physical witnesses by content component.
completeness_statement: Official Vatican manuscript digitization portal; not limited to biblical material.
notes: Object-level terms require later review.

title: e-codices — Virtual Manuscript Library of Switzerland
scope_filter: Search Bible, Evangelia, Psalter, and biblical shelfmarks; separate noncanonical components.
completeness_statement: National-scale virtual manuscript library with full digital facsimiles for many items; not Bible-only.
notes: Use stable manuscript URLs for direct records.

title: Biblissima Portal
scope_filter: Filter for digitized biblical manuscripts; verify holding-institution object and canon component before admission.
completeness_statement: Scholarly linked-data discovery portal aggregating manuscript resources; direct images remain distributed.
notes: Prefer the holding institution as direct-copy authority.

title: Fragmentarium
scope_filter: Search biblical fragments and require work/component identification before canonical routing.
completeness_statement: Specialist digital laboratory for manuscript fragments; content scope and image coverage are record-dependent.
notes: Especially important for dispersed fragments.

title: Digital Scriptorium Catalog
scope_filter: Search biblical titles/subjects and Has Images = Yes; verify the member institution's record.
completeness_statement: US union catalog connecting researchers to premodern manuscript books; supplied metadata and images vary by member.
notes: Aggregator metadata may be inconsistent; use direct institutional records where possible.

title: Digital Bodleian
scope_filter: Search Hebrew manuscripts, Western medieval manuscripts, Bible, Gospel, Psalter, and named shelfmarks.
completeness_statement: Official portal with over a million images and substantial fully digitized Hebrew and medieval holdings; not Bible-only.
notes: Use item records for stable direct pointers.

title: Cambridge Digital Library
scope_filter: Search Bible manuscripts and named witnesses; split mixed codices by component.
completeness_statement: Official Cambridge digital collections root; automated verification was unavailable, so item-level currency needs recheck.
notes: Known home of Codex Bezae and Codex Zacynthius digital records.

title: Chester Beatty Digital Collections Viewer
scope_filter: Search Biblical Papyri and confirm canonical book component; deuterocanonical papyri route to boundary.
completeness_statement: Official viewer for Chester Beatty holdings; automated verification was unavailable and object links should be rechecked.
notes: CSNTM also exposes catalog records for several Chester Beatty biblical papyri.

title: Trinity College Dublin Digital Collections
scope_filter: Search Book of Kells and other biblical manuscripts by title or shelfmark.
completeness_statement: Official digital collections portal; not Bible-only.
notes: Direct stable object pointer is recorded separately.

title: Manuscripts in St. Catherine's Monastery, Mount Sinai
scope_filter: Search biblical manuscripts and verify component; collection contains liturgical and other works too.
completeness_statement: Official Library of Congress collection of photographed Sinai manuscripts; not exhaustive of all Sinai holdings.
notes: Physical custody and image provenance must remain explicit.

title: Sinai Palimpsests Project
scope_filter: Select identified canonical biblical undertexts; route noncanonical, liturgical, and patristic texts separately.
completeness_statement: Specialist multispectral collection; automated verification was unavailable and record links need recheck.
notes: Undertext identification is scholarly evidence, not canon authority.

title: Gallica
scope_filter: Search biblical manuscript titles and BnF shelfmarks; require manuscript/facsimile filter and component review.
completeness_statement: Official BnF digital library; very broad collection, not a Bible-specific catalog.
notes: Prefer ARK item URLs for direct records.

title: British Library Archives and Manuscripts Catalogue
scope_filter: Search named biblical codices and shelfmarks; catalog records do not always expose a current image viewer.
completeness_statement: Official catalogue root for British Library manuscript records; digital-image availability is item-dependent.
notes: The former Digitised Manuscripts service has changed; retain direct catalogue IDs.

title: SLUB Dresden Digital Collections
maintainer: Sächsische Landesbibliothek — Staats- und Universitätsbibliothek Dresden
scope_filter: Search biblical manuscripts and shelfmarks such as A 145b.
completeness_statement: Official digital collection; automated access encountered bot protection, but repository evidence includes stable object links.
notes: Direct Codex Boernerianus pointer is recorded separately.

title: Manuscriptorium
maintainer: National Library of the Czech Republic and partners
scope_filter: Search biblical manuscripts and digitized-document availability; verify originating institution.
completeness_statement: European written-heritage aggregator with distributed digital objects; not Bible-only.
notes: Keep originating-institution provenance.

title: Manus Online
maintainer: ICCU — Istituto Centrale per il Catalogo Unico
scope_filter: Search Italian-held biblical manuscripts and digital-copy links; verify each institution's object.
completeness_statement: Official Italian manuscript census/catalog; digitization is record-dependent.
notes: Catalog authority and digital-object authority may be different institutions.

title: Pinakes — Textes et manuscrits grecs
scope_filter: Use for Greek manuscript identities and bibliography; confirm digital facsimiles at holding institutions.
completeness_statement: Major Greek manuscript census/discovery aid; current automated availability was not verified.
notes: Not a digital-image host by default.
